You must opt-in for this category. Please be honest when opting-in. If you've been designing the game for 3 years, even if it wasn't made public before, it wouldn't really qualify for this category.
The contest timeframe is defined "from June 1st", i.e. the start of the contest, not from the Earliest Date.

text:
Thematic/Mechanic category: BEST AI SYSTEM IN A GAME

Not every solo has (or needs) an Artificial Intelligence system, but it's a common occurrence to have one, either as an opponent or as the game itself changing its state to challenge the player.
The best AI systems should be easy for the user to handle, and not require the player to make any decisions for/against themselves.
They can be somehow random, but without feeling random (i.e. you should feel the AI has a purpose for what it's doing).

All games are automatically entered into this prize category.

Top 10 Best AI System in a Game

This category should not consider build size or complexity, but quality of the files in regards to building the game at home.

text:
Person category: BEST ARTIST

This category is for the best artist creating original art for a game in the contest.
This category is separate from Graphic Design, as that refers to the layout and usability, while this category is for aesthetics of the cards and components, and table presence.

CC, Public Domain art or AI-generated art (Midjourney, Dall-E, etc) cannot participate on this category. Please do not mention an Artist on your entry, or clearly indicate if all your art is stock, CC, public domain or AI-generated art.
Please read the Important information regarding generative AI and its use in this contest.

Games that explicitly mention an artist are automatically entered into this prize category.

CC, Public Domain art or AI-generated art (Midjourney, Dall-E, etc) cannot participate on this category. Please do not mention an Artist on your entry, or clearly indicate if all your art is stock, CC, public domain or AI-generated art.
Please read the Important information regarding generative AI and its use in this contest.

Games that explicitly mention an artist are automatically entered into this prize category.

Special category: THEMATIC CHALLENGE: Battle of Wits: Mythology

I used a random theme generator to create the challenge for the contest. This category is completely optional, and only for the designers that want to participate in this year's theme, and implement it in their game.


The theme can be interpreted in any way the designer finds acceptable, even stretching the meaning, using it as literally or as metaphorically as wanted, but it must be clear that the game is informed by the theme, and not so far-fetched that it requires a thorough explanation to discover the link to it.
The setting in this category is optional, and just for inspiration. You may use a different setting.

You must opt-in for this category.
